title: GPIO: Digital and Analog I/O
subtitle: Pins, voltage levels, pull-up resistors, and ADC

content.text: GPIO pins let your microcontroller interact with the physical world: read buttons, control LEDs, talk to sensors.
Always use INPUT_PULLUP instead of INPUT when reading buttons. Floating inputs give random readings.

questions.question: What does INPUT_PULLUP do?
options: Connects an internal resistor to Vcc so unconnected pins read HIGH
questions.explanation: A pull-up resistor keeps the pin at HIGH when nothing is connected. When the button is pressed, it pulls the pin to LOW/GND.

faq.q: Can I connect a 5V signal to a Raspberry Pi GPIO?
faq.a: No! Raspberry Pi GPIO is 3.3V. A 5V signal will damage it. Use a voltage divider or a logic level converter.
